'''Clarelle''' was a short-tempered, [[Color/Legends|dark]]-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] who resided in [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She operated a stable and made a living by renting out [[Dewback/Legends|Dewbacks]].
